title: NimbleBrain host context
description: The authenticated context a NimbleBrain host stamps on every request it sends to a plugin server, at params._meta["ai.nimblebrain/context"]: who is calling and the scope the call is walled to. The host sets it and overwrites any value a caller supplied. A server believes it only from an authenticated host transport. A value that fails this schema is no context: the call names no principal, so it is not host, and has no scope. Normative rules: contracts/host-context/CONTEXT.md in the NimbleBrain repository.

principal.description: Who is calling: host, the host's own code, or person, a user directly or through an agent or an app.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the call is walled to. Absent when the call is made outside any workspace.

ownerId.description: The verified identity whose records the call reads and writes. Absent when no identity is in scope.

conversationId.description: The conversation the call is made inside, when it is made during a chat turn. Absent outside a chat.

runId.description: The unattended run the call is made inside, or that a host call is made for. Absent outside a run.

grant.description: The run grant for this call's workspace and owner, stamped on a person call to a tool its contract marks grant: true. Opaque to the server: it stores the value with a definition that will run unattended and returns it verbatim; only the host reads it. Absent on every other call.

unattended.description: True when a person call is made inside an unattended run (a task run), with no person present. A server refuses a tool its contract marks unattended: refused. Never on a host call; absent or false otherwise.
